I recommended $BTDR at $11. Today it’s trading around $8. If I’m honest, it’s my biggest loser of the year, detracting 3 percentage points from my portfolio performance.

But not all neoclouds are created equal.

I previously warned about $CRWV, which I considered the most dangerous player because of its terrible balance sheet and massive debt. Now its problems are dragging down the entire sector.

Bitdeer is different. It’s a leader in Bitcoin mining, designing and manufacturing its own SEALMINER machines. That gives it greater control over its technology, costs and expansion.

While many competitors have shifted their focus to AI, $BTDR has aggressively expanded its Bitcoin mining operations, becoming one of the world’s largest miners.

Even at $80K Bitcoin, its mining business alone could support a meaningful part of its $2.2B valuation.

Unlike pure neoclouds, BTDR has a substantial Bitcoin mining business alongside its AI ambitions.
